facts_of_case: Applicants/accused seek relief under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

legal_principles.principle: Once a notice is served on a party, it is not required that repeated invitations should be sent by the Court to the non-applicants/respondents.
legal_principles.held: The purpose of service of notice on the party/parties is that the concerned party/parties should have intimation about pendency of the matter against it before this Court.
